disclosure: This model keeps the standalone GNK ASG d.o.o. financial base separate from the consolidated GNK DINAMO Ltd. Group base. FY2025 baselines are tied to official public-registry documents and portal copies. Interim 30 June 2026 values are management inputs derived from the stated 98% ratio and are not audited or guaranteed results.

periods.interimStatement: Management input states that revenue, profit, assets, capital and liabilities at 30 June 2026 are approximately 2% below the corresponding full-year 2025 headline values.

sources.authority: FINA — Registar godišnjih financijskih izvještaja / Javna objava
sources.scope: Official public FY2025 audited standalone GNK ASG d.o.o. financial statements

sources.authority: Colorado Secretary of State — Business Database Search
sources.scope: Official public business filing record containing the publicly filed GNK DINAMO Ltd. FY2025 consolidated report
Public portal presentation and download layer for both FY2025 reports
Executive Office management input that 30 June 2026 headline values are approximately 98% of FY2025

interimManagementInput.calculation: FY2025 headline values x 0.98; equity ratio held at the published FY2025 percentage

comparisonRules.reason: GNK DINAMO Ltd. Group is a consolidated group view and may already include connected-company activity. Standalone and consolidated figures must not be added without a documented elimination and consolidation method.
allowed: budget-envelope calculation within each selected scope

flowMetrics.description: Revenue and profit are treated as flow metrics. H2 is modelled as a percentage of H1.

stockMetrics.description: Assets, capital and liabilities are point-in-time balances and are not annualised. Year-end values require balance-sheet assumptions or a later actual source.
